look.setBy: LOOK_SCRIPT in <head> (src/lib/theme.ts), from localStorage key 'look' = 'skin/palette'; nothing stored = saturday/sunburst
paletteMustDefine: PALETTE_COLORS entry (ground, paper, ink, accent, both, me, partner)

display.purpose: Page titles, wordmark and intro on the ground: cream fill, ink stroke max(2px, 0.05em) painted under the fill, text-shadow 0.07em 0.07em 0 ink. Utility: display.

headline.purpose: The spotlight's head: display treatment filled with --pop.

title.purpose: Section heads and tabs on paper, plain ink. Utility: display-ink.

numeral.purpose: Live clocks, night tickets and Stats tiles, tabular.

item-title.purpose: List entries, title cards, night titles.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Cards, spotlight, list rows (8px on row hover). --lift.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Buttons, selected chips, icon buttons, nav bar; grows on hover, 0 on press. --lift-sm.

shadows.name: poster
shadows.purpose: Posters, current tab, Stats tiles, checked settings option.

shadows.name: peel-sheet
shadows.purpose: Trailing edge of a page peeling away; the only soft shadow.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: The one motion clock: presses, hovers, pops, poster morph (420ms), pick-deal. Overshoot once, settle.

motion.name: pick-deal
motion.purpose: A new pick deals in from the right with a spin.

motion.name: nav-pill-travel
motion.purpose: Pill travels and stretches between sections.

motion.name: jiggle
motion.purpose: Nav tabs passed on the way.

motion.name: intro
motion.value: 1700ms, once per launch (sessionStorage), skippable by tap or key
motion.purpose: Burst spins in with 'Two Couches!', swaps for couches, cover spins open via a burst-shaped hole, burst lands on the measured header logo. Off with reduced motion.

motion.name: whoosh
motion.value: out 260ms cubic-bezier(.55,0,.85,.35); in 440ms cubic-bezier(.22,1.2,.36,1), delayed 90 + 75ms per passed section
motion.purpose: Forward page transition with speed lines and passed-section previews. Transform and opacity only.

motion.name: peel
motion.value: out 360ms (300ms with passed sections) cubic-bezier(.5,0,.75,.4); in 460 + 80ms per passed section cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1)
motion.purpose: Back transition: opaque ground sheet peels right, passed sections peel after it 80ms apart, earlier page rises from 0.965 scale.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Header pill nav from here; bottom tab bar below.

layout.readingColumn: 48rem unless the page root sets data-wide

components.name: Bright Button
components.description: The bright cartoon button that squashes when pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Luckiest Guy', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #1d1a2b; background: #ffd23f; border: 2.5px solid #1d1a2b; border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 16px 8px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1d1a2b; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px) rotate(-1deg); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #1d1a2b; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px) scale(1.03, 0.95); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #1d1a2b; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a4cf5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1a2b; background: #fffaf0; border: 2.5px solid #1d1a2b; border-radius: 14px; padding: 6px 14px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1d1a2b; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #1d1a2b; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a4cf5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter and toggle chip; grape when aria-pressed / aria-current / aria-checked / checked input.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1a2b; background: #fffaf0; border: 2.5px solid #1d1a2b; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-2deg); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] { background: #6a4cf5; color: #fff; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1d1a2b; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a4cf5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #1d1a2b; background: #ff2e93; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Big outlined view tabs; the current one tips and turns grape.
components.html: Up nextWatched
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-tab { font-family: 'Luckiest Guy', sans-serif; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: #1d1a2b; text-decoration: none; background: rgb(255 250 240 / 0.75); border: 3px solid #1d1a2b; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 16px 6px; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #fffaf0; } .ds-tab[aria-current=page] { background: #6a4cf5; color: #fff; transform: rotate(-2deg); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #1d1a2b; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a4cf5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Paper input; focus drops a grape offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; color: #1d1a2b; background: #fffaf0; border: 3px solid #1d1a2b; border-radius: 14px; padding: 8px 14px; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #4a4360; } .ds-field:focus { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #6a4cf5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Paper cut-out panel with ink outline and hard shadow; list rows tilt and wiggle.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 4px; font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; color: #1d1a2b; background: #fffaf0; border: 3px solid #1d1a2b; border-radius: 22px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #1d1a2b; rotate: -0.5deg; transition: box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #1d1a2b; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #4a4360; }

components.name: Spotlight
components.description: The one grape panel per screen, with a pop-filled display head and swapped text tokens.
components.html:
Next watch night

in 24 hours
components.css: .ds-spot { display: grid; gap: 12px; font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: #6a4cf5; border: 3px solid #1d1a2b; border-radius: 22px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #1d1a2b; rotate: -1deg; } .ds-spot-head { margin: 0; font-family: 'Luckiest Guy', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #ffd23f; -webkit-text-stroke: 2px #1d1a2b; paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0.07em 0.07em 0 #1d1a2b; } .ds-spot-muted { margin: 0; color: #e2dbff; }

components.name: Both Burst
components.description: Bubblegum 12-point starburst that pops onto anything you can both watch.
components.html: Both of us!
components.css: .ds-burst { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 80px; height: 80px; rotate: -8deg; animation: ds-pop 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1) both; } .ds-burst svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; } .ds-burst-word { position: relative; max-width: 78%; text-align: center; font-family: 'Luckiest Guy', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 0.9; color: #fff; -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px #1d1a2b; paint-order: stroke fill; } @keyframes ds-pop { 0% { scale: 0; rotate: -30deg; } 70% { scale: 1.15; rotate: 6deg; } 100% { scale: 1; rotate: -8deg; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-burst { animation: none; } }

components.name: Couch Mascot
components.description: One little couch per person in their colour; bobs and blinks, the partner a beat behind.
components.css: .ds-couches { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-couch { overflow: visible; transform-origin: bottom center; animation: ds-bob 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-couch-partner { margin-left: -8%; animation-delay: 0.6s; } @keyframes ds-bob { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-1.5deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-couch { animation: none; } }

components.name: Name Tag
components.description: A person's name on a pill in their colour, always with ink text.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: Fredoka, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1a2b; border: 2.5px solid #1d1a2b; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0 10px; } .ds-tag-me { background: #ff8a65; } .ds-tag-partner { background: #5cc8ff; }

narrative.overview:
The app is a Saturday-morning cartoon about two people on two couches, hours apart. Every screen is a sunny cel: a sunshine-yellow ground with rays fanning down from above the top of the screen, and cream paper panels cut out in thick ink outlines that cast hard, flat ink shadows. The two people are two little couches with faces, one coral and one sky blue, bobbing and blinking a beat apart. A bubblegum starburst pops onto a title only when both of you can watch it. Nothing else is that loud.

The look is a skin plus a palette, chosen per device and set on <html> before the first paint (data-skin, data-palette, written by LOOK_SCRIPT from localStorage). The skin owns fonts, outline weight, corner radii, shadow offsets, decorations and motion. The palette owns every colour. Components read only the tokens, so a new skin or palette is a new CSS block plus an entry in SKINS / PALETTE_COLORS, not a component rewrite. Today there is one skin, Saturday Morning (saturday), with one palette, Sunburst (sunburst). Sticker Scrapbook, POW! Comic Book and Candy Shop are planned as skins, and more palettes will come from a palette lab.

Density is relaxed and playful but legible: 17px Fredoka for reading, big cartoon lettering only for page titles, section heads, tabs and numbers. Panels lean a little (about -1 to 1 degrees), and rows wiggle when pointed at. Everything that moves overshoots once and settles. The world rejects the streaming-service dashboard (dark grids, glass, backdrop heroes) and timid "playful" SaaS (pastel cards with a mascot sticker on top).
keyCharacteristics: Sunburst ground (yellow plus conic rays) under cream paper panels with 3px ink outlines and hard offset ink shadows.
One grape spotlight panel per screen. Its display head is filled in pop yellow.
Coral and sky person colours are fills only (couches, dots, name tags). They never colour text.
The bubblegum starburst and the stamp colour mean "both of you" and nothing else.
Luckiest Guy lettering with an ink stroke and a hard shadow on the ground; Fredoka for everything you read.
One spring clock (cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1)): pop, wiggle, squash, bob and blink. Reduced motion turns it all off.

rules.name: The Overlap Rule
rules.body: Bubblegum (--stamp, --both) appears only where the two of you overlap: a title you can both stream or both being ready. It is never decoration, never a status like "under way", never a generic alert.

rules.name: The Fill-Only Rule
rules.body: Coral and sky are fills with ink text and an ink outline. They are never text colours, borders or rules.

rules.name: The One Spotlight Rule
rules.body: One grape spotlight panel per screen, for that screen's moment. Grape elsewhere marks only selection, done states or data, always at small scale.

rules.name: The Token Swap Rule
rules.body: Text tokens follow their surface. The page, .card, .paper, .field, .chip, .btn and .btn-quiet reset --ink, --muted, --line and --focus to the palette's paper values. .spotlight swaps them: ink becomes on-accent, muted becomes grape-muted, lines become rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35), --both becomes spotlight-both-text and focus becomes pop. A paper element inside the spotlight is readable without extra classes.

rules.name: The Ground-or-Paper Rule
rules.body: Cartoon lettering on the ground or the spotlight gets the full display treatment (fill, stroke, shadow). On paper it is display-ink: plain ink, no stroke, no shadow.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: body sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so times, counts and dates never jitter as they tick.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Every shadow except the peel sheet is a zero-blur offset in ink. No soft ambient shadows, no glows, no glass.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Interactive things lift on hover (translate up-left, bigger offset) and land in their shadow on press. Disabled things lose their shadow.

dos: Do put every surface on cream paper with a 3px ink outline and a flat ink offset shadow (6px panels, 3px controls, 4px posters).
Do use bubblegum only where the two of you overlap: the Burst for "both can watch", the dot on "We can both watch" filters, both being ready.
Do keep coral and sky as fills with ink text and an ink outline (couches, dots, name tags, ticket dots).
Do give each screen exactly one grape spotlight for its moment, with its head in pop-filled display lettering.
Do use full display lettering on the ground and spotlight, and display-ink on paper.
Do mark selected chips, tabs and options with aria-pressed, aria-current, aria-checked or a checked input, and let the CSS turn them grape.
Do move on the spring clock (cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1)), animate only transform and opacity in transitions, and gate every loop and entrance behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
Do take every colour from tokens, so a new palette changes the whole app.
Do draw icons as SVG from icons.tsx, and keep pages in the 48rem column unless the root sets data-wide.
donts: Don't use the bubblegum stamp for statuses, alerts or decoration that isn't about both of you.
Don't set text in coral or sky. Neither passes contrast as text.
Don't add soft, blurred or coloured ambient shadows, glass, backdrop blur or dark streaming-dashboard grids. The peel sheet's edge shadow is the only soft one.
Don't put a second spotlight on a screen, or fill large areas with grape outside it.
Don't hard-code hex values or use dark: variants in components. Write a palette block instead.
Don't put stroke-and-shadow display lettering on paper, or plain display-ink on the ground.
Don't animate blur, filters or fixed backgrounds in page transitions, or play the intro more than once per launch.
Don't use glyph characters for icons or arrows in strings, or uppercase small tracked labels above headings.
